I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj run --compiled` and prints the expected output for both examples.

I ran the three lines from example 2 plus `255 10 16` through it as one input. The output was `10`, `10100001111`, `0` and `FF`. I did not test values near 2^63 - 1 or malformed lines.

The program skips any line with fewer than three fields. It reads each digit by looking it
